# Fixtures that fail today, accepted as a baseline rather than fixed.
#
# One repo-relative fixture path per line; `#` starts a comment.
# The runner (Tests/runner/caret-fixtures.mjs) reports these as "known" and
# does not fail the run on them, the same convention as docs/known-failing-tests.md.
# If a listed fixture starts passing, the runner says so and asks for the line
# to be deleted.
#
# Adding a line here silences a failure, so add one only deliberately.
# Deletions are always fine: deleting a line is what fixing the bug looks like.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tests/fixtures/mouse/23-triple-click-line.txt
#
# NOT A CONFIRMED BUG. An unresolved design question, recorded so the harness
# does not quietly adopt either answer.
#
# Expected: a triple click selects "alpha beta", the paragraph text.
# Actual:   it selects "alpha beta\n", the paragraph plus its line break.
#
# CodeMirror's behaviour matches VS Code and most code editors, where a triple
# click plus Cmd+X is meant to lift the whole line out. Chalk is not a code
# editor: the writing surface is modelled on iA Writer (see the .editor-host
# comments in web/src/chalk-theme.css), and prose editors in that family
# select the paragraph without the break, so that pasting it does not
# introduce a blank line.
#
# The fixture encodes the prose-editor answer because that is what Chalk is.
# If the owner prefers the code-editor answer, change the fixture's expect
# block and delete this entry. Do not "fix" it in code without that decision.
Tests/fixtures/mouse/23-triple-click-line.txt
